instruction: Change VLC's progress bar slider colors to darker shades to match a dark theme.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VLC's slider colors to darker shades. The evaluator uses existing check_qt_slider_colours metric with type='blackish' to verify all RGB color values in qt-slider-colours setting are below threshold (100). Default colors are bright (153;210;153;20;210;20;255;199;15;245;39;29), so user must navigate to VLC preferences and change slider colors to darker values.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly retrieves VLC configuration file (vlcrc) across different platforms
Metric correctly parses qt-slider-colours setting and validates all RGB values are below threshold (100) for 'blackish' type
Expected value handling is correct - metric receives rules dict directly and accesses rule['type'] appropriately
Postconfig properly restarts VLC to ensure configuration changes are applied before verification
Complete coverage - evaluator verifies the exact requirement (slider colors changed to darker shades)
Edge cases handled - default value used if setting not in config, robust RGB parsing logic
